polishes.description: This listing is for a MINI bottle (6.5 mL). For the full size polish, use this listing. A peachy coral jelly base filled with silver holo microflakes plus red-orange-gold-green shifting multichrome flakes. Photos show 3 coats with glossy topcoat. Because of the liquid medium needed to suspend the multichrome flakes, the bases on these are more sheer than some of my other similar polishes. You may prefer 3 coats for fuller coverage. While the flakes in this polish are very thin and lie flat on the nail, the polish dries a bit dull without topcoat. Note that holographic polishes show their rainbow sparkle best under a source of bright, direct light, such as natural sunlight or a halogen bulb lamp. Swatch photos are taken in direct lighting, with a glossy topcoat, to best show the holo effect. In most holo polishes, there will still be some sparkle in indoor lighting, but the strong holo rainbow effect may be muted or not show up.
